Live Scorecard alert 29 on main 89b4aa8bb4d9fd4ece4e9865905929d41cc84515 is open: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/security/code-scanning/29. The October 2 all-dependency pnpm audit reports 7 high and 5 moderate Axios advisories; production audit reports zero.
